speaker: Narrator
text: Snow begins to fall as the two travellers reach the mouth of the high pass.

speaker: Mira
text: "I mean to find my brother before the snows close the road," Mira says, tightening her scarf. "He went up this way a month ago."

speaker: Doran
text: "And I want the bounty on the bandits up there, nothing more," Doran grunts. "Your brother is your business."

speaker: Narrator
text: Together they step into the pass, the wind howling between the cliffs.
